item.title: Best Buddy – Feb 17 – The Royal Family
item.description: This week we have a special guest, Moose Media News Director Franki who actually cared for these adorable kittens, and their mom. item.description: Stage North's production of 9 to 5 still has shows tonight at tomorrow night at the NPCC (get your tickets now at npcc.bc.ca), but they're also holding auditions for their next show that will be performed in May. JP is here to talk about "War of The Worlds" and "Sleepwalker", a pair of radio shows he's looking to perform live with actors and live sound effects.
